archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Tech SaaS Aesthetic applied to NGO)
global_rules: Clone arcads.ai feel: Massive typography, plenty of negative space, crisp white backgrounds, scroll-driven reveals.
Bilingual support (FR/EN) architecture integrated via routing or state.
Strict use of Tailwind CSS and custom HTML sections for marketing pages, Shadcn for forms/CMS elements.
GSAP for all complex scrollytelling. Do not use framer-motion if GSAP is doing the heavy lifting to avoid conflicts.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-[#0A0A0A]

animations_gsap.scrollytelling_hero: Pin the hero section on scroll. The massive typography scales down (scale: 0.8) and fades out (opacity: 0), while the background image/video wrapper scales up from a masked center to full viewport width/height. Use ScrollTrigger scrub: true.
animations_gsap.fade_up_stagger: Use ScrollTrigger. Elements translate Y from 40px to 0, opacity 0 to 1, with a stagger of 0.1s. Easing: 'power3.out'.
animations_gsap.horizontal_scroll: Pin the container. Translate X the inner flex wrapper based on scroll progress (-100% + viewport width) for the 'Programmes' cards. scrub: 1.
animations_gsap.parallax_images: Image wrappers have `overflow-hidden`. The inner `img` translates Y (e.g., yPercent: 20) with scrub: true to create parallax effect within its container.
animations_gsap.stats_counter: ScrollTrigger fires a counter from 0 to target value when the stats section enters the viewport. Easing: 'expo.out' over 2.5s. Pin the stats section briefly.

sections.name: Hero Scrollytelling
sections.layout: h-screen flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden bg-white
sections.content: Massive Montserrat headline 'CULTIVONS LA DÉMOCRATIE'. Below it, a masked image (congo landscape). On scroll, text fades, image expands to cover screen.

sections.name: Les 3 Piliers (Bento Grid)
sections.layout: Grid Tetris Mode: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Pillar 1 spans 8 cols, Pillars 2 & 3 span 4 cols each.
sections.content: Cards for Terre et Communauté, Participation, Rayonnement. Arcads.ai style: borderless, white bg, extremely subtle shadow, sharp hover transforms.

sections.name: Impact (Counter)
sections.layout: py-32 bg-[#F8F9FA] flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh]
sections.content: Huge numbers (e.g., 500k+) in Green #1A8F4D. GSAP animated counter. Subtext in Open Sans text-[#736B63].

sections.name: Actualités / Blog
sections.content: Latest posts. Image tops, clean typography below. Hover effects on image (scale up 1.05).

sections.name: Mission & Vision
sections.content: Text heavy, high readability. Large Montserrat quotes.

sections.name: Horizontal Scroll Gallery
sections.content: Dark mode section for contrast. GSAP horizontal scroll. Each program is a massive card taking up 80vw, bleeding off screen.

sections.name: Masonry List
sections.layout: CSS Columns or Grid Masonry max-w-7xl mx-auto py-24
sections.content: Blog cards varying in height, minimal text, strong imagery. Hover reveals.

sections.name: Stripe Donation Form
sections.content: Clean SaaS-style form using Shadcn inputs. Pre-selected amounts ($10, $50, $100). Green Vital primary button.

nav_sticky.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-[#736B63]/10 transition-transform duration-300
nav_sticky.behavior: Hide on scroll down, reveal on scroll up using GSAP or standard React state.
nav_sticky.elements: Logo left, Nav links center, Translate toggle (FR/EN) and 'Faire un don' CTA right.

cards_programmes.style: bg-white p-8 md:p-12 rounded-3xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] border border-[#736B63]/5 hover:-translate-y-2 transition-all duration-500
cards_programmes.content: Icon/Image top, bold H3 text-[#0A0A0A], thin body text-[#736B63]. Learn more link with arrow.

chatbot_gemini.style: fixed bottom-8 right-8 z-50 w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-[#1A8F4D] shadow-[0_12px_24px_rgba(26,143,77,0.3)] flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer hover:scale-110 transition-transform
chatbot_gemini.behavior: Click toggles a chat window powered by Gemini 3. Window has white bg, crisp borders.

footer.style: bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white py-24 px-8 rounded-t-[3rem] mt-20
footer.content: Massive 'CENADEP' logo/text, coordinates in RDC, clean column layout for links.

image_urls.description: Congo landscape for the hero scrollytelling reveal

instructions_to_main_agent: Install GSAP via yarn (`yarn add gsap`) and import ScrollTrigger.
Do not use `.tsx`, generate `.js` files as per project environment.
Implement the pages with React Router for multipage architecture.
Implement the translation feature (FR/EN) using a simple context or state, modifying static text strings.
Use Shadcn UI for the donation form and contact forms. Do not reinvent inputs.
Ensure all components have `data-testid` for robust testing.
